==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I created a floating brain made of Lucid Light to talk to. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.)
Together we brainstormed ideas for horror stories, by traveling into our idea worlds.
Eventually we settled on a Western horror about a sharpshooting kid who hunts fairies for their pixie dust.
